newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to sell 110 trillion lira T-bills to public.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to sell 110 trillion lira T-bills to public.

text.p: The Turkish Treasury will offer 362-day, 110 trillion lira nominal-valued t-bills to the public next week, at an interest rate of 97 percent, excluding witholding tax, the central bank said on Friday.
The offer to take place on May 21 via banks and brokerage houses will be the first public offer of government papers since June 1996.
The interest rate including witholding tax will be 111.75 percent on the bills having May 18, 1998 maturity.
The intermediaries will earn a commission of 0.75 percent on their net sales of the bills to investors.
